newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cbank sets two-week rev repo, max 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech cbank sets two-week rev repo, max 25 pct.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) on Thursday set a two-week reverse repo tender to drain funds from the market at a maximum rate of 25 percent, a CNB statement said.
The maximum rate is unchanged from a similar tender on Wednesday.
The CNB said it would accept two bids from participants of a minimum 100 million crowns until 09.40 a.m. (0740 GMT) in the operation.
The central bank has been holding several tenders on almost a daily basis over the past few weeks in order to drain liquidity from the market and help support the crown.
